title: erucaria pinnata var. major
intro: Erucaria pinnata var. major, commonly known as  Brassica rapa var. major, is a plant species in the Brassicaceae family. It is a type of leafy green vegetable and a variant of the wild cabbage plant. The health benefits of Erucaria pinnata var. major include its high nutritional value, with rich content of vitamins A, C, and K, as well as minerals such as calcium and iron. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, which have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
